individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial plots show per-spot (per-location) deconvolution scores directly on the tissue section, equivalent to a heatmap/scatter of individual data points rather than a summary average.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the spatial plots, so nothing needs to be defined.

individual-data-points.explanation: The box plots have individual data points (dots for each spot/sample) overlaid on top of the box-and-whisker summary.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Caption explicitly defines the box plot elements (minima, median, maxima, Q1, Q3) for every group shown.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing a running enrichment score; individual data points are not applicable to this plot type.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown on the GSEA enrichment line plots.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each bar is a single log2 fold-change statistic derived from a differential gene expression analysis on pooled spatial transcriptomics data, not a mean of discrete replicate measurements that would require overlaid points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown on the bar graph of log2 fold changes.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E is composed of micrographs, not a plot, so error bars are not applicable.
